C0647.title: Employee's Misdirected Email Leaks Trade Secrets; Shenzhen Longgang Court Rules Dismissal Lawful
C0647.summary: In August 2020, Liang, an employee of a Shenzhen company, mistakenly sent an email containing a partner company trade secrets to a competitor of partner customer Company B, causing leakage of trade secrets. The company terminated the labor contract under the confidentiality agreement and employee handbook. The court held that Liang failed to exercise due care, and the company termination was lawful without compensation.
